_how_to_use: Copy this file to deliverables/user_testing.json, replace the example tester with real results (one object per tester), then run: python scripts/build_report.py and python scripts/build_slides.py

testers.who: EXAMPLE ONLY: student, age 15, has dyslexia
testers.confusing: EXAMPLE: didn't notice the Sum it up button at first
testers.one_sentence: EXAMPLE: It reads to you and explains the hard parts.
quotes: EXAMPLE quote in the tester's own words
testers.needed_help: EXAMPLE: asked where the read-aloud button was
